manifest: FACTORY-F01-IMPL-01 bounded C-F01 PAPER canary cohort pack
assignment: Codex ruling issuecomment 6513808658 (parallel implementation; only activation waits)

parity_contract.head: 9fd904a1cbb696d8d3adbeba076376568f18c5af
parity_contract.status_at_pack: SIGNED (ruling 6513888459), not merged; pin amendment proposed in pin_amendment.v1.json
parity_contract.rule: the parity contract governs; this pack only operationalizes it. A contract amendment that changes bounds, preconditions or pins supersedes this pack

environment: PAPER / Binance Futures testnet only. Never mainnet, never MODE / LIVE_CONFIRM, never credentials

flag.default: absent (OFF). With the flag missing, malformed or OFF, an enabled C-F01 is refused every new entry (Codex 6514109966 #2); other slots are unaffected

shape.on: true (exactly the JSON boolean) = ON; anything else = OFF
shape.start_utc: tz-aware ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, written while C-F01 is disabled and IN THE FUTURE at preflight time; never moved
shape.authorization_comment_id: the Integration (Codex) authorization comment id: a positive numeric GitHub comment id
shape.cohort_dir: REQUIRED: an absolute evidence directory outside the repo
shape.source_commit: the accepted MERGED source commit (full 40-hex) the installed build must come from (build.json source_commit)

source_manifest.value: {file: sha256 of its bytes with CRLF normalized to LF} computed by f01_canary.source_manifest(<checkout of the accepted commit>)

flag.testnet_guard: honoured only when Engine.live is False AND the trading client base URL is exactly binance_client.TESTNET; otherwise every new C-F01 entry is refused and logged (S7, fail closed)
does_not: enable C-F01 (its SLEEVES enabled flag stays Integration's switch)
flag.code: f01_canary.py; engine.py Engine.f01_canary_block (called from Engine._rules_block, automatic entries only), Engine.f01_canary_preflight, Engine._f01_extract / _f01_decision (observe-only hooks in miss, _audit_opened, _measured_close, _measured_followup); observe-only raw sizing capture in open_lot / _create_lot (pin_amendment.v1.json); frame capture hook in Engine.candles (not pinned) -> 'frame' extracts
flag.pinned_functions_untouched: 31 of the 34 pinned functions are unchanged; open_lot and _create_lot carry the observe-only capture recorded in pin_amendment.v1.json, and candidate_guard takes self.lock per contracts/cand_evict_ack_01/pin_amendment.v1.json (ruling 6518282215) (re-hash tests in tests/test_factory_f01_impl01.py and tests/test_cand_evict_ack_01.py)

bounds.counting: C-F01 rows opened AND closed at / after start_utc with a usable unique string id; history first, then the cohort store by id (a row without a usable id or close time fails closed); a pre-canary lot is never counted
bounds.drawdown_basis: cumulative measured net R (row_view measured / acknowledged pnl / risk_usd) from a 0 R start; the peak includes 0; drawdown = max(peak - cum)
bounds.pending_rule: any counted C-F01 close with pending costs (row view, or the durable candidate_cost_pending index) blocks new C-F01 entries until measured (fail closed)
bounds.on_reach: new C-F01 entries refused with the bound text; open lots keep confirmed protection and normal management; nothing is force-closed (OQ8)

scoring_start_rule: OQ2 (Codex 6514109966 #3): >= 250 older closed 4h bars are warm-up only. A decision is scored only when its 4h bar opened at / after start_utc AND the engine confirmed it fully closed (bar open + 4h <= the decision time). The bar spanning start_utc is excluded; the next fully closed bar is the first scored bar

preflight.call: Engine.f01_canary_preflight(pins_expected=<pins_expected below>, write=True) -> {pass, checks{ENV, STAGE, C1, C1b, C2..C10}, recorded, record_sha256, extract_sha256}
preflight.read_only: engine state and settings are never changed; write=True only adds the immutable preflight extract under cohort_dir
preflight.pass_rule: every check ok. STAGE: C-F01 disabled. C5: no drift and the frozen card incl. share == 1/6. C9: installed-build provenance - build_info.BUILD_ID not 'dev', the matching build.json source_commit equals the frozen source_commit, the running source manifest equals the frozen source_manifest, every pin matches (no git read: the installer strips .git). C10: flag on, well-formed config, start_utc in the future at preflight time

clean_cohort_record_template.reset: candidate-flat (C1): no C-F01 / C-F02 lot or pending / resting / unconfirmed / deferred entry; no pre-canary lot imported
clean_cohort_record_template.notes: no order, trade, stop or client ids

rollback.owner: Integration only (Build and Evidence never edit settings)
rollback.command: On the PAPER bot only, through its own settings path with the bot running: SLEEVES[id == 'C-F01'].enabled = false (one field). No installer, no restart, no MODE / LIVE_CONFIRM change. (F01_CANARY.on = false also refuses new C-F01 entries, but the slot flag is the recorded rollback.)
steps: R1 Integration sets the C-F01 slot enabled = false
R2 open C-F01 lots are not closed: they keep confirmed exchange protection and normal signal / stop management (OQ8)
R2b force-close only for unknown account state, lost / unrestorable protection, environment uncertainty or a separately recorded safety decision
R3 after the next 4h cycle confirm: no new C-F01 entry, every open C-F01 lot has a confirmed stop (no stop_miss), C-F02 enabled false
R4 finalize the extracts with the stop condition id; Cowork publishes verdict.json

telemetry_checks_read_only: each 4h cycle: bot log lines 'FACTORY-F01 canary:' (logged once per distinct refusal reason)
settings: F01_CANARY unchanged since authorization; C-F01 enabled as authorized; C-F02 enabled false
state: candidate_disabled has no C-F01 entry (S1); no C-F01 lot with stop_miss_why restoring / owner_check (S3); no C-F01 candidate_cost_pending entry >= 6 h old (S4)
f01_canary.bound_status(cfg, history rows, candidate_cost_pending) -> closed, net_r, drawdown_r, stop (S5 / S6)
cohort_dir/extracts/*: each file name equals the sha256 of its bytes (ExtractWriter.records verifies)

stop_conditions.S2: a MUST-MATCH parity divergence (incl. P13 C-F02 activity)
stop_conditions.S5: 4.0 R measured net drawdown from the canary peak (runtime gate)
stop_conditions.S6: 30 calendar days or 8 closed C-F01 trades (runtime gate)
stop_conditions.S7: mainnet / live / credential / non-testnet event (runtime gate refuses)

evidence_outputs.runtime_extracts: extracts/{decision,trade,preflight}/<sha256>.json - canonical JSON (sorted keys, ASCII, non-finite floats as {"float": "nan"}), written once (exclusive create); the same bytes again = no-op, different bytes = error
evidence_outputs.finalize: ExtractWriter(cohort_dir).finalize() -> preflight.json, frames_manifest.json, decisions.csv, trades.csv, MANIFEST.sha256 ("<sha256>  <name>" per line); each file written once; trades.csv qty_raw / stop_raw are the exact captured pre-quantization values
evidence_outputs.not_by_build: verdict.json (Cowork, OQ7); the rp_* / causal_window_id / result columns stay empty in Build's CSVs
evidence_outputs.frames: extracts/frame/<sha256>.json per closed 4h frame engine.candles built for a C-F01 symbol while the canary is ON (symbol, tf, first / last bar open, rows, frame_sha256 = sha256 of canonical JSON rows [open ms, o, h, l, c, v]); each decision extract carries the frame_sha256 of its bar; finalize writes frames_manifest.json (per symbol, sorted)

pins_expected._source: parity contract code.pinned_function_sha256 at d255b3f (= signed 9fd904a) with pin_amendment.v1.json applied (open_lot, _create_lot)
pins_expected._amended_cand_evict_ack_01: engine.py:Engine.candidate_guard 90125553420ccb52ca7cc9ecfcbcfd53d14b214bdc21c8417476bc020307215a -> 5c70e0d9ae7a8efec736c4035795e51b051aeebfae42cd6c6cc6181877530748 (body wrapped in with self.lock:) per CAND-EVICT-ACK-01 pin ruling Codex 6518282215 (contracts/cand_evict_ack_01/pin_amendment.v1.json); manifest-only correction ruled by Codex 6518560081. two_stage_start.a: with C-F01 still DISABLED, Integration writes the immutable authorized F01_CANARY config (on, authorization id, cohort_dir, source_commit, source_manifest) with a FUTURE start_utc
two_stage_start.b: run Engine.f01_canary_preflight(pins_expected, write=True): checks ENV, STAGE (C-F01 disabled), C1-C10 (C10: start_utc strictly in the future); record record_sha256 / extract_sha256
two_stage_start.c: only after PASS, Integration enables C-F01 (SLEEVES enabled = true) BEFORE start_utc; the gate refuses entries until start_utc
two_stage_start.d: on FAIL, C-F01 stays disabled; fix the cause and re-run (b) - with a new future start if the old one has passed
invariants: no bar spanning start_utc is scored (scored = bar open >= start_utc and engine-confirmed closed)
